newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bancomext says Q1 financing $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bancomext says Q1 financing $1 billion.

text.p: Mexico's foreign trade bank Bancomext granted close to $1 billion in credits, underwriting and guarantees during the first quarter of 1997, a director of the development bank told Reuters in an interview.
"Of this amount, $250 million accounted for investment banking," Bancomext Associate Director of Business Promotion Abel Jacinto said.
Of the remainder, $100 million has been chanelled into guarantees, leaving the rest available for credits to small and medium-sized businesses, Jacinto said.
When asked whether this amount was not modest compared with Bancomext's $10 billion financing budget for 1997, Jacinto said credit flows tended to be light at the beginning of the year.
"More credits are usually granted during the second quarter of the year," he said.
Bancomext will seek to assist 84,000 small and medium-sized exporting companies in starting up and developing projects. Jacinto said the bank expected 80,000 to seek its services.
